), lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.leg_no
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.parent_security_name
		, ss.abor_security_type_name as parent_security_type_name
		, ss.abor_instrument_type_id as parent_instrument_type_id
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO REFERENCE DATA */
	left join 
		reference.scd_securities ss
			on mhl.business_date = cast( ss.business_date as date )
			and mhl.parent_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name = unitization.pool_name

	select

		, pool_name

		, total_market_value_pc
		, bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, parent_quoted_currency_code
		, parent_quoted_currency_name
		, currency_of_exposure_code
		, currency_of_exposure_name
		, case
			when upper(country_of_exposure_name) in ( 'NOT APPLICABLE', 'NOT AVAILABLE', 'DEVELOPED OTHER' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_code in ( 'X0' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_name = 'EUROPE (EX UK)' then 'EU'
			else country_of_exposure_code
		  end country_of_exposure_code
		, case
			when upper(country_of_exposure_name) in ( 'NOT APPLICABLE', 'NOT AVAILABLE', 'DEVELOPED OTHER' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_code in ( 'X0' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_name = 'EUROPE (EX UK)' then 'EUROPEAN UNION'
			else country_of_exposure_name
		  end country_of_exposure_name
		, country_of_exposure_code as country_of_exposure_code_original
		, country_of_exposure_name as country_of_exposure_name_original
		, leg_no
		, parent_security_number
		, parent_security_name

	from

	select
		  lt_clean.*
		, case
			when parent_security_type_name in ( 'Medium term debt', 'Internal Term Debt Issuance', 'IRS Interest Rate' ) then 'CURRENCY'
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'Securities lending', 'Call money', 'Deposit', 'Cash bucket', 'CD', 'CP' ) then 'CURRENCY'
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'FX Forward' ) then 'COUNTRY'
			when leg_no = 2 and parent_security_type_name in ( 'Options-OTC-Credit', 'TRS Equity IC', 'TRS Fixed Income IC', 'Options-OTC-Equity' ) then 'CURRENCY'
			when country_of_exposure_code is null and currency_of_exposure_code is null then 'QUOTED CURRENCY'
			when country_of_exposure_code is null then 'CURRENCY'
			else 'COUNTRY'
		  end lkp_typ

			when parent_security_type_name in ( 'Medium term debt', 'Internal Term Debt Issuance', 'IRS Interest Rate' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'Securities lending', 'Call money', 'Deposit', 'Cash bucket', 'CD', 'CP' ) then currency_of_exposure_code

			when leg_no = 2 and parent_security_type_name in ( 'Options-OTC-Credit', 'TRS Equity IC', 'TRS Fixed Income IC', 'Options-OTC-Equity' ) then currency_of_exposure_code

	select
		  lt_lkp.*
		, mapping.external_reporting_dm_em
		, mapping.external_reporting_region
		, regexp_replace( coalesce( mapping.external_reporting_country, mapping.lkp_nme ), '(\w)(\w*)', x -> upper(x[1]) || lower(x[2])) as external_reporting_country
	from
		lt_lkp
	left join
		mapping
			on lt_lkp.lkp_value = mapping.lkp_value

	select
		  lt_map.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, case 
			when external_reporting_country in ( 'China', 'Hong Kong', 'Taiwan', 'Macao' ) then 'Greater China'
			when external_reporting_country = 'India' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region = 'Europe' then 'DM Europe'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' then 'Other DM'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'
		  end external_reporting_dm_em_region
		, case
			when currency_of_exposure_code in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
	from
		lt_map
), lt_final_agg as (
	select *
	from (
		select
			  lt_agg.business_date
			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_02
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, business_date_string
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, year_month
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, business_date_string
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, year_month
		) lt_agg
		cross join unnest( -- UNVPIVOT ACCOUNTS
			array [ 'bCPP', 'aCPP' ],
			array [ bcpp_total_market_value_pc, acpp_total_market_value_pc ]
		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )
	)
	where total_market_value_pc is not null and total_market_value_pc != 0
)

), lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.leg_no
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.parent_security_name
		, ss.abor_security_type_name as parent_security_type_name
		, ss.abor_instrument_type_id as parent_instrument_type_id
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO REFERENCE DATA */
	left join 
		reference.scd_securities ss
			on mhl.business_date = cast( ss.business_date as date )
			and mhl.parent_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name = unitization.pool_name

	select

		, parent_quoted_currency_code
		, parent_quoted_currency_name
		, currency_of_exposure_code
		, currency_of_exposure_name
		, case
			when upper(country_of_exposure_name) in ( 'NOT APPLICABLE', 'NOT AVAILABLE', 'DEVELOPED OTHER' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_code in ( 'X0' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_name = 'EUROPE (EX UK)' then 'EU'
			else country_of_exposure_code
		  end country_of_exposure_code
		, case
			when upper(country_of_exposure_name) in ( 'NOT APPLICABLE', 'NOT AVAILABLE', 'DEVELOPED OTHER' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_code in ( 'X0' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_name = 'EUROPE (EX UK)' then 'EUROPEAN UNION'
			else country_of_exposure_name

		, country_of_exposure_name as country_of_exposure_name_original

		, investment_structure_level_01
		, investment_structure_level_02
	from
		lt_base
	where
		id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug

	select
		  lt_clean.*
		, case
			when parent_security_type_name in ( 'Medium term debt', 'Internal Term Debt Issuance', 'IRS Interest Rate' ) then 'CURRENCY'
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'Securities lending', 'Call money', 'Deposit', 'Cash bucket', 'CD', 'CP' ) then 'CURRENCY'
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'FX Forward' ) then 'COUNTRY'
			when leg_no = 2 and parent_security_type_name in ( 'Options-OTC-Credit', 'TRS Equity IC', 'TRS Fixed Income IC', 'Options-OTC-Equity' ) then 'CURRENCY'
			when country_of_exposure_code is null and currency_of_exposure_code is null then 'QUOTED CURRENCY'

			else 'COUNTRY'

			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'Securities lending', 'Call money', 'Deposit', 'Cash bucket', 'CD', 'CP' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'FX Forward' ) then 'CA'
			when leg_no = 2 and parent_security_type_name in ( 'Options-OTC-Credit', 'TRS Equity IC', 'TRS Fixed Income IC', 'Options-OTC-Equity' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			when country_of_exposure_code is null and currency_of_exposure_code is null then parent_quoted_currency_code
			when country_of_exposure_code is null then currency_of_exposure_code

		, mapping.external_reporting_dm_em
		, mapping.external_reporting_region
		, regexp_replace( coalesce( mapping.external_reporting_country, mapping.lkp_nme ), '(\w)(\w*)', x -> upper(x[1]) || lower(x[2])) as external_reporting_country
	from
		lt_lkp
	left join
		mapping
			on lt_lkp.lkp_value = mapping.lkp_value

	select
		  lt_map.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, case 
			when external_reporting_country in ( 'China', 'Hong Kong', 'Taiwan', 'Macao' ) then 'Greater China'
			when external_reporting_country = 'India' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region = 'Europe' then 'DM Europe'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' then 'Other DM'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'

		, case

			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
	from
		lt_map

	select *
	from (
		select
			  lt_agg.business_date
			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01

			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, business_date_string
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, year_month
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, business_date_string
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, year_month
		) lt_agg
		cross join unnest( -- UNVPIVOT ACCOUNTS
			array [ 'bCPP', 'aCPP' ],
			array [ bcpp_total_market_value_pc, acpp_total_market_value_pc ]
		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )
	)
	where total_market_value_pc is not null and total_market_value_pc != 0
)

with old_breached_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        max(business_date) first_breach_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_breach = 'N'
    group by limit_name,

    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_breach = 'Y'
        and limit_id not in (

    group by limit_name,

),

    select *

    union all

            from old_alert_records
        )
    group by limit_name,

    union all
    select *

SELECT * FROM (WITH params AS (
            SELECT from_iso8601_date( NULL ) AS query_date
        ),
	adjusted_date AS (
		SELECT
			query_date,
			CASE
				WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 1 THEN query_date - interval '3' day
				WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 7 THEN query_date - interval '1' day
				ELSE query_date - interval '1' day
				END AS business_date
		FROM params
	),
     account_mapping_query AS (
         SELECT
             date_format(ad.query_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS BUSINESS_DATE,
             pam.mx_portfolio_id AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
             pam.bbg_pfolio_id AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
             pam.model_portfolio AS SCD_ACCOUNT,
             pam.sst_account AS SST_ACCOUNT
         FROM reference.model_portfolio_account_mapping pam
                  JOIN adjusted_date ad ON pam.as_of_date = ad.business_date
             )
        SELECT
            COALESCE(BUSINESS_DATE, '') as BUSINESS_DATE,
            COALESCE(TRIM(MUREX_PORTOFOLIO), '') as MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
            COALESCE(TRIM(BBG_ACCOUNT), '') as BBG_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(SCD_ACCOUNT), '') as SCD_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(SST_ACCOUNT), '') as SST_ACCOUNT
        FROM account_mapping_query
        UNION
        SELECT
            date_format(ad.query_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS BUSINESS_DATE,
            '' AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
            '' AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(scd.model_portfolio_id), '') AS SCD_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(scd.sst_custody_account_code), '') AS SST_ACCOUNT
        FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio scd
                 JOIN adjusted_date ad ON CAST(scd.business_date AS DATE) = ad.business_date

            SELECT 1
            FROM account_mapping_query fq
            WHERE COALESCE(TRIM(fq.SCD_ACCOUNT), '') = COALESCE(TRIM(scd.model_portfolio_id), '')
              AND COALESCE(TRIM(fq.SST_ACCOUNT), '') = COALESCE(TRIM(scd.sst_custody_account_code), '')
        )) T LIMIT 0

                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
             ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-03' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                           OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-03' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                           THEN fact.mt_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "mt_exposure",
            child.mt_cash_pb_fi_limit AS "mt_smd_threshold",
                    SUM(
                            CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                            ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-03' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                            OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE p.business_date = '2025-06-03' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                            THEN fact.lt_exposure
                            ELSE 0
                            END
                    ) AS "lt_exposure",
            child.lt_cash_pb_fi_limit AS "lt_smd_threshold",
                    SUM(
                            CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                            ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-03' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                            OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-03' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                            THEN fact.credit_exposure
                            ELSE 0
                           END
                    ) AS "total_cash_pb_exposure",
            child.total_cash_pb_smd_fi_limit AS "total_cash_pb_smd_limit",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                           EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-03' and p.product_type_category = 'REPOS' AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "repo_sbl_exposure",
            child.repo_fi_limit AS "repo_sbl_smd_threshold",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                           EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-03' and p.product_type_category = 'DERIVATIVES' AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "der_exposure",
            child.der_fi_limit AS "der_smd_threshold",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                           EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-03' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "total_der_repo_sbl_exposure",
            child.der_repo_fi_limit AS "total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                           (
                           EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-03' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) OR
                            ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-03' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                            OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-03' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                           )
                           THEN fact.credit_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "isrc_total_exposure",
            child.isrc_total_fi_limit AS "isrc_total_limit",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                           (
                           EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-03' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) OR
                            ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-03' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                            OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-03' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                           )
                           THEN fact.credit_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "smd_total_exposure",
            child.smd_total_fi_limit AS smd_total_limit
            FROM dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child
            INNER JOIN fact_cr_exposure fact
            ON fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and fact.chron_id = child.chron_id
            INNER JOIN dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent
            ON child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and parent.chron_id = child.chron_id
            INNER JOIN dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos
            ON fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id and pos.chron_id = fact.chron_id
            LEFT OUTER JOIN ref_country parent_country
            ON parent.domicile_country_code = parent_country.alpha_2_code and parent.chron_id = parent_country.chron_id
            LEFT OUTER JOIN ref_country child_country
            ON child.domicile_country_code = child_country.alpha_2_code and child_country.chron_id = child.chron_id
            WHERE
            child.business_date = '2025-06-03'
            AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) <> 'NETTING'
            AND
                    (
                            parent.is_fi = 'Y'
                            OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
                            OR EXISTS
                                    (
                                            SELECT 1
                                            FROM dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
                                            WHERE
                                            sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                                            AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                                            AND sibling.chron_id = child.chron_id
                           AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
                    )
                )
            GROUP BY
            parent.party_name,
                    parent.cppib_party_id,
                    coalesce( parent_country.name, parent.domicile_country_code ),
                    parent.rtg_final,
                    parent.rtg_outlook,
                    child.party_name,
                    child.cppib_party_id,
                    coalesce( child_country.name, child.domicile_country_code ),
                    child.rtg_final,
                    child.rtg_outlook,
                    child.st_cash_pb_fi_limit,
                    child.mt_cash_pb_fi_limit,
                    child.lt_cash_pb_fi_limit,
                    child.total_cash_pb_smd_fi_limit,
                    child.repo_fi_limit,
                    child.der_fi_limit,
                    child.der_repo_fi_limit,
                    child.isrc_total_fi_limit,
                    child.smd_total_fi_limit
            ),
            child_level_exp_limits AS
            (
                    SELECT
            'N' AS "is_parent",
            party_name_child AS "entity_name",
                    party_name_parent AS "parent_name",
                    CASE
                           WHEN SUM( st_exposure ) >= MAX( st_smd_threshold ) THEN 'EXCESS'
                           WHEN SUM( mt_exposure ) >= MAX( mt_smd_threshold ) THEN 'EXCESS'
                           WHEN SUM( lt_exposure ) >= MAX( lt_smd_threshold ) THEN 'EXCESS'
                           WHEN SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) >= MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ) THEN 'EXCESS'
                           WHEN SUM( der_exposure ) >= MAX( der_smd_threshold ) THEN 'EXCESS'
                           WHEN SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) >= MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ) THEN 'BREACH'
                           WHEN SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) >= MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ) THEN 'BREACH'
                           WHEN SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) >= MAX( isrc_total_limit ) THEN 'BREACH'
                           WHEN SUM( smd_total_exposure ) >= MAX( smd_total_limit ) THEN 'BREACH'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ) / MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ) / MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ) / MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ) / MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ) / MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ) / MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ) / MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ) / MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) / MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) / MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) / MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) / MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( smd_total_exposure ) / MAX( smd_total_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( smd_total_exposure ) / MAX( smd_total_limit ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ) / MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ) / MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ) / MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ) / MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ) / MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ) / MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ) / MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ) / MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) / MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) / MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) / MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) / MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( smd_total_exposure ) / MAX( smd_total_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( smd_total_exposure ) / MAX( smd_total_limit ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
            ELSE 'OK'
            END AS "status",
                   country_code_child,
                    coalesce( rtg_final_child, '-' ) AS "rtg_final",
            coalesce( rtg_outlook_child, '-' ) AS "rtg_outlook",
            CAST (ROUND( SUM( exposure_expiring ), 2 )AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "exposure_expiring",
            CAST (ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ), 2 )AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "st_exposure",
            coalesce( CAST (ROUND( MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "st_smd_threshold",
            coalesce( CAST (ROUND( MAX( st_smd_threshold ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( st_exposure ) ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)) , '-')
            AS "st_available",
                    CAST (ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "mt_exposure",
            coalesce( CAST (ROUND( MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "mt_smd_threshold",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( mt_smd_threshold ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( mt_exposure ) ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-')
            AS "mt_available",
                    CAST (ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ), 2)  AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "lt_exposure",
            coalesce( CAST (ROUND( MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "lt_smd_threshold",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( lt_smd_threshold ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( lt_exposure ) ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-')
            AS "lt_available",
                    /* Comment this out until GCM can handle these new fields after July 7, 2017 Abacus 3.1 release */
                   coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "total_cash_pb_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 2 )AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "total_cash_pb_smd_limit",
            coalesce( CAST (ROUND( MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) ), 2 )AS VARCHAR(255)), '-')
            AS "total_cash_pb_available",
                    CAST (ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "repo_sbl_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "repo_sbl_smd_threshold",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )
            AS "repo_sbl_available",
                    CAST (ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "der_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "der_smd_threshold",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( der_smd_threshold ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( der_exposure ) ), 2 )AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )
            AS "der_available",
                    CAST (ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "total_der_repo_sbl_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-')
            AS "total_der_repo_sbl_available",
                    CAST (ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "isrc_total_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "isrc_total_limit",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( isrc_total_limit ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) ), 2 )AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )
            AS "isrc_total_available",
                    CAST (ROUND( SUM( smd_total_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "smd_total_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( smd_total_limit ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "smd_total_limit",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( smd_total_limit ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( smd_total_exposure ) ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )
            AS "smd_total_available",
                    cppib_party_id_child,
                   cppib_party_id_parent
            FROM curr_exposure c
            GROUP BY
            party_name_child, party_name_parent, country_code_child, rtg_final_child, rtg_outlook_child,
    cppib_party_id_child, cppib_party_id_parent--, 'N', coalesce( rtg_final_child, '0' ), coalesce( rtg_outlook_child, '0' )
            ),
            breaches_under_parents_tbl AS
            (
                    SELECT
            cppib_party_id,
                --MIN( status ) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY LENGTH( status ) DESC) AS status
               DENSE_RANK () OVER(ORDER BY LENGTH(status) DESC) as state, status
             --MIN(STATUS) as STATUS
            FROM
                    (
                            SELECT
                            cppib_party_id_parent AS "cppib_party_id",
                            CASE
                           WHEN
                           ((NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_cash_pb_exposure,'\-')) and (NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_cash_pb_smd_limit,'\-')) and (CAST(total_cash_pb_exposure AS DECIMAL) >= CAST(total_cash_pb_smd_limit AS DECIMAL)))
                           OR ((NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_der_repo_sbl_exposure,'\-')) and (NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,'\-')) and (CAST(total_der_repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL) >= CAST(total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit AS DECIMAL)) )
                           OR ((NOT REGEXP_LIKE(isrc_total_limit,'\-')) and (NOT REGEXP_LIKE(isrc_total_exposure,'\-')) and (CAST(isrc_total_exposure AS DECIMAL) >= CAST(isrc_total_limit AS DECIMAL)))
                           OR ((NOT REGEXP_LIKE(smd_total_limit,'\-')) and (NOT REGEXP_LIKE(smd_total_exposure,'\-')) and (CAST(smd_total_exposure AS DECIMAL) >= CAST(smd_total_limit AS DECIMAL))) THEN 'BREACH'
                           --WHEN der_exposure >= der_smd_threshold OR repo_sbl_exposure >= repo_sbl_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
                          WHEN ((NOT REGEXP_LIKE(der_smd_threshold,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(der_smd_threshold,'\-') and (CAST (der_exposure AS DECIMAL) >= CAST(der_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL))) OR (NOT REGEXP_LIKE(repo_sbl_smd_threshold,'\-') AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(repo_sbl_exposure,'\-') AND (CAST(repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL ) >= CAST(repo_sbl_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL)))) THEN 'EXCESS'
                          WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_cash_pb_exposure,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_cash_pb_smd_limit,'\-') and ( CAST (total_cash_pb_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (total_cash_pb_smd_limit AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST(total_cash_pb_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (total_cash_pb_smd_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( CAST(total_cash_pb_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (total_cash_pb_smd_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_der_repo_sbl_exposure,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,'\-') and ( CAST (total_der_repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND(CAST  (total_der_repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND(CAST  (total_der_repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(isrc_total_limit,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(isrc_total_exposure,'\-') and ( CAST (isrc_total_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (isrc_total_limit AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST (isrc_total_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (isrc_total_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( CAST (isrc_total_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (isrc_total_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(smd_total_limit,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(smd_total_exposure,'\-') and ( CAST (smd_total_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (smd_total_limit AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST (smd_total_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (smd_total_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( CAST (smd_total_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (smd_total_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(der_smd_threshold,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(der_exposure,'\-') and ( CAST (der_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (der_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST (der_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (der_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( CAST (der_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (der_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(repo_sbl_smd_threshold,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(repo_sbl_exposure,'\-') and ( CAST (repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (repo_sbl_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST (repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (repo_sbl_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( CAST (repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (repo_sbl_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_cash_pb_exposure,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_cash_pb_smd_limit,'\-') and ( CAST (total_cash_pb_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (total_cash_pb_smd_limit AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST (total_cash_pb_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (total_cash_pb_smd_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( CAST (total_cash_pb_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (total_cash_pb_smd_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_der_repo_sbl_exposure,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,'\-') and ( CAST (total_der_repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST (total_der_repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( CAST (total_der_repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(isrc_total_limit,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(isrc_total_exposure,'\-') and ( CAST (isrc_total_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (isrc_total_limit AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST (isrc_total_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (isrc_total_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( CAST (isrc_total_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (isrc_total_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(smd_total_limit,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(smd_total_exposure,'\-') and ( CAST (smd_total_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (smd_total_limit AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST (smd_total_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (smd_total_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( CAST (smd_total_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (smd_total_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                          WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(der_smd_threshold,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(der_exposure,'\-') and ( CAST (der_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (der_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST (der_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (der_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( CAST (der_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (der_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(repo_sbl_smd_threshold,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_cash_pb_smd_limit,'\-') and ( CAST (repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (repo_sbl_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST (repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (repo_sbl_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( CAST (repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (repo_sbl_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
            ELSE 'OK'
            END AS status
            FROM child_level_exp_limits
             ) p
            GROUP BY cppib_party_id, status
            ), breaches_under_parents as (select cppib_party_id, MIN(status) as status FROM breaches_under_parents_tbl where state = 1 GROUP BY cppib_party_id)
            SELECT
            'Y' AS "is_parent",
            party_name_parent AS "entity_name",
                           party_name_parent AS "parent_name",
                   CASE
                           WHEN b.status = 'EXCESS'
                           OR SUM( der_exposure ) >= MAX( der_smd_threshold )
                           OR SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) >= MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold )
                           OR SUM( st_exposure ) >= MAX( st_smd_threshold )
                           OR SUM( mt_exposure ) >= MAX( mt_smd_threshold )
                           OR SUM( lt_exposure ) >= MAX( lt_smd_threshold )
                           THEN 'EXCESS'
                           WHEN b.status = 'BREACH'
                           OR SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) >= MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit )
                           OR SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) >= MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit )
                           OR SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) >= MAX( isrc_total_limit )
                           OR SUM( smd_total_exposure ) >= MAX( smd_total_limit )
                           THEN 'BREACH'
                           WHEN b.status = 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ) / MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ) / MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) )
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ) / MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ) / MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) )
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ) / MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ) / MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) )
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ) / MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ) / MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) )
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) )
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) / MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) / MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) )
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) )
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) / MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) / MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) )
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( smd_total_exposure ) / MAX( smd_total_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( smd_total_exposure ) / MAX( smd_total_limit ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) )
                           THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN b.status = 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ) / MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ) / MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) )
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ) / MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ) / MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) )
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ) / MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ) / MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) )
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ) / MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ) / MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) )
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) )
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) / MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) / MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) )
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) )
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) / MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) / MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) )

                           THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
            ELSE 'OK'
            END AS "status",
                    country_code_parent,
                           coalesce( rtg_final_parent, '-' ) AS "rtg_final",
            coalesce( rtg_outlook_parent, '-' ) AS "rtg_outlook",
            CAST (ROUND( SUM( exposure_expiring ), 2)  AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "exposure_expiring",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' ) AS "st_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' ) AS "st_smd_threshold",

            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( mt_smd_threshold ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( mt_exposure ) ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-')

            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' ) AS "lt_smd_threshold",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( lt_smd_threshold ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( lt_exposure ) ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )

                    /* Comment this out until GCM can handle these new fields after July 7, 2017 Abacus 3.1 release */
                           coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' ) AS "total_cash_pb_exposure",

WITH curr_exposure AS
            ( 
                    SELECT
             parent.party_name AS "party_name_parent",  
            parent.cppib_party_id AS "cppib_party_id_parent",  
            coalesce( parent_country.name, parent.domicile_country_code ) AS "country_code_parent",

            child.rtg_final AS "rtg_final_child",  
                    child.rtg_outlook AS "rtg_outlook_child",  
            SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND pos.days_to_maturity = 1 THEN fact.credit_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS "exposure_expiring",  
            SUM(  
                   CASE  
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND  
                   ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-03' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                   OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-03' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                   THEN fact.st_exposure
                   ELSE 0
                   END
            ) AS "st_exposure",
            child.st_cash_pb_fi_limit AS "st_smd_threshold",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
             ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-03' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                           OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-03' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                           THEN fact.mt_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "mt_exposure",
            child.mt_cash_pb_fi_limit AS "mt_smd_threshold",
                    SUM(
                            CASE

                            OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE p.business_date = '2025-06-03' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )

                            OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-03' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )

                           END

            child.isrc_total_fi_limit AS "isrc_total_limit",

                            ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-03' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
